# Deck slide outline

**Auto-generated by `make report`** (`deck/build_deck.py`) from the results
catalog — this committed copy is a placeholder until you run it. Regenerate any
time after `make demo`; edit freely afterwards.

The `deck/` folder collects the **hero clips** (photoreal Blender renders on the
Windows host) and this **slide outline** for the PowerPoint. The headline
deliverable is video: annotated MP4 clips per scenario.

Run:

```bash
make demo      # produces clips + catalog, then assembles this outline
make report    # (re)assemble this outline from the catalog
```

Recommended hero clips (photoreal, host-side): `droid_replay_reach_check`
(the Project-2 bridge shot) and `human_clearance_pickplace` (the safety breach).
